audit_items.proof_trace: During BeaconSync, blocks without parents are validated via ValidateOrphanedBlock (line 51-58), which only checks EIP4844 fields and does NOT call ValidateTransactions. These blocks are then inserted directly into the block tree (NewPayloadHandler.cs:485) without transaction gas limit validation, potentially allowing blocks with tx.gasLimit > 16777216 to be accepted during sync.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker sends malformed blocks with oversized transaction gas limits during the BeaconSync window when the node is syncing and parents are not yet available. These blocks bypass ValidateTransactions and are inserted directly, potentially causing consensus divergence or DoS when the node attempts to execute them.
